data.design: Small ceramic keepsake with blue-reed identity; use the existing item reference for its precise icon.

questions.question: Does the keepsake eventually have a practical use?

description:
A small ceramic charm from the seller’s hometown, given as a personal thank-you after the necklace returns. Its blue-reed identity recalls the meal and borrowed plate. It is not the key to Mother’s vault.

No power is established for the keepsake; its value as a thank-you does not require one.

sections: Section 10.7: pie, necklace and delayed pearl meaning
